verified_requirements_summary: waste and hazardous-waste handling within applicable law
DEMOLITION.rule: No ritual date may authorize demolition before these requirements/readiness are satisfied.

TEMPORARY_SUPPORT.rule: Temporary supporting structures require design/installation/checking/use/dismantling safety as applicable.

SEQUENCING_SAFETY.rule: Construction sequence must maintain stability and worker/public safety; ceremonial sequence cannot alter a safe technical sequence.

WEATHER_AND_SITE.rule: If weather/site conditions make work unsafe, traditional date result becomes NO_WORK_TECHNICAL_HOLD.
